description.en: Visual review inside the harness browser: point at any element to comment on it, adjust styles live with rollback, sketch on a free-form annotation canvas (brush, lines, arrows, rectangles, ellipses, numbered steps and text), and send everything as structured context attached to the next message, with cropped or full-page screenshots composited with the drawings.
description.zh: 在 harness 浏览器内做可视化评审：指向任意元素添加评论、实时调整样式并可回滚、在自由画布上批注草图（画笔、直线、箭头、矩形、椭圆、编号步骤和文字），然后作为结构化上下文随下一条消息发送，截图（局部或整页）会合成所画的批注。
